evaluation_coverage.comments: The framework evaluates both knowledge assets and execution workflows using comprehensive quality dimensions.

objectivity.comments: Evaluation criteria, scoring methodology, and review guidance minimize subjective interpretation.

repeatability.comments: Standardized scorecards, structured schemas, and documented review processes enable consistent evaluations.

actionability.comments: Quality assessments produce clear findings and improvement recommendations that support continuous refinement.

governance_readiness.comments: The framework incorporates review guidelines, versioning practices, and governance responsibilities.

traceability.comments: Evaluation records are linked to asset versions, although future dashboards could further improve historical visibility.

scalability.comments: The framework is reusable across multiple knowledge domains and AI-first systems.

continuous_improvement_support.comments: The framework encourages periodic reviews, tracks recommendations, and supports iterative quality improvements.

strengths: Reusable across knowledge and workflow assets
Supports continuous improvement throughout the asset lifecycle
improvement_opportunities: Introduce automated quality dashboards for monitoring trends.
Expand historical reporting with longitudinal quality analytics.
Integrate automated quality checks into future Knowledge Operations pipelines.
recommendation: Approved as the standard quality evaluation framework for AI-ready knowledge assets and execution workflows.
